title: CoLaX: Context-Aware Local Explanations for Time Series Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.15067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-hoc explanations for time series classifiers usually score local patterns, such as subsequences or shapelets, without regard to the rest of the sequence. Yet the same motif can carry different predictive meaning under different global temporal conditions, such as trends or regimes. We propose CoLaX, a context-aware post-hoc explanation framework that builds on shapelet-driven Shapley attribution and conditions local-pattern relevance on a learned representation of the full sequence. Global context acts at two levels: it produces sample-specific prototype weights and a temporally resolved signal that reweights the local activation map. The resulting context-conditioned segments are the players of a Shapley attribution game whose values come only from the frozen black-box classifier. On synthetic benchmarks where identical motifs change relevance across contexts, CoLaX improves AUPRC over the strongest baseline by 30\% on average. O

translated_title: CoLaX：面向时间序列分类的上下文感知局部解释
translated_abstract: 针对时间序列分类器的事后解释方法通常对局部模式（如子序列或shapelet）进行评分，而不考虑序列的其余部分。然而，同一个模体在不同的全局时间条件（如趋势或状态）下可能具有不同的预测意义。我们提出了CoLaX，这是一个上下文感知的事后解释框架，它建立在shapelet驱动的Shapley归因之上，将局部模式的相关性以完整序列的学习表示作为条件。全局上下文在两个层面发挥作用：它生成样本特定的原型权重，以及一个时间上可解析的信号，用于重新加权局部激活图。由此得到的上下文条件化片段成为Shapley归因博弈的参与者，其值仅来自冻结的黑盒分类器。在相同模体在不同上下文中相关性发生变化的合成基准上，CoLaX在AUPRC指标上平均比最强基线提高了30%。
tldr: CoLaX提出了一个上下文感知的时间序列分类事后解释框架，利用全序列的学习表示调节局部模式相关性并结合shapelet驱动的Shapley归因，在合成基准上平均将AUPRC比最强基线提高30%。
en_tdlr: CoLaX is a context-aware post-hoc explanation framework for time series classification that conditions local-pattern relevance on a learned full-sequence representation via shapelet-driven Shapley attribution, improving AUPRC by 30% on average over the strongest baseline on synthetic benchmarks.
